discordPostHtml:
Obtainable Shroud and Threat
Lets you construct a "sane" version of shroud and threat vessels using the Shrouded Substrate menu.

  • Does NOT modify the vanilla Shroud and Threat hulls.
  • All hulls have been copied and modified to have sane logistics/Flux/DP/OP stats.
  • Threat hulls come with built in "Fragment Swarm" hullmod.
  • Shroud hulls come with built in "Shrouded Mantle" hullmod.
  • Maelstrom no longer crashes if you put beam weapons on it (thx Alex).
  • Dollar sign is purely cosmetic as the function Alex made only works for weapons (thx Alex).

Please let me know if you experience any crashes/balans issues.
Redownload Nex if you get a "Cannot invoke "com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.InteractionDialogAPI.getPlugin()" because "dialog" is null" crash.
Forum Thread : https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=32014.0
Download : https://github.com/ymfah/Obtainable-Shroud-and-Threat/releases/latest/download/Obtainable.Shroud.and.Threat.zip
aiDescription: Allows players to build Shroud and Threat vessels using the Shrouded Substrate menu. These ships are copies of the vanilla hulls with adjusted logistics, Flux, DP, and OP stats. Threat ships include the Fragment Swarm hullmod, while Shroud ships include the Shrouded Mantle hullmod.

gallery.aiCaption: A ship hull blueprint menu listing various units like 'Shrouded Maw' and 'Shrouded Eye' with their costs.
A space battle scene featuring large red nebula-like ships and detailed combat statistics overlays.
A grid of ship sprites labeled with 'ordnance points left' values such as '300 ordnance points left' and '200 ordnance points left'.
A grid of ship variants showing red Shroud entities and grey Threat ships with ordnance point counts.
A battle scene featuring large red Shroud ships and grey Threat vessels firing at each other in space.
The ship hull blueprint menu listing obtainable Shrouded Dweller and Threat ships such as the Shrouded Maw and Fabricator Unit.
